cmd.create: Start a new giveaway in a channel
cmd.end: End a running giveaway now and pick the winners
cmd.reroll: Pick new winners for an ended giveaway
cmd.delete: Delete a giveaway and its message
cmd.duration: How long it runs, like 30m, 1h or 5d
cmd.channel: Where to post it (default: this channel)
cmd.gdelete: Deletes a giveaway message and removes it from the database.
cmd.gend: End a giveaway now and pick the winners
cmd.greroll: Pick new winners for an ended giveaway

guildOnly: This command can only be used in a server.
